players.product: Lithium niobate (LN) optical modulators for optical communications, incl. next-generation LN modulator (CDM) and ultra-high-speed optical modulation sub-assemblies

quarterly_data.signal: Facility (translated from Japanese): consolidated subsidiary Akiyoshi Mining completed the extension and renewal of the limestone ship-loading berth at Senzaki Port (Nagato, Yamaguchi), held the completion ceremony on October 8, 2026 and expanded from one berth to two, with a new jetty extension, ship loader and belt conveyors (construction from April 2023, all work completed September 2026), improving ship turnaround and shipping efficiency; the Akiyoshi mine, one of Japan's largest limestone mines, supplies steel, chemical, cement and aggregate uses and exports to nearby Asian countries.
quarterly_data.figure: 1 berth to 2 berths; all work completed September 2026
